      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Plugin request logs lose the traceID field",
      "body": "The previous LoggerMiddleware explicitly appended traceID from the tracing context to the plugin request log entry. This change removes that explicit field and relies on Logger.FromContext, but the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware only adds endpoint, pluginId, datasource, and user fields. Unless the underlying logging infrastructure independently injects trace IDs, plugin backend request logs will no longer include traceID, reducing trace/log correlation."
    },

      "file": "pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/metrics_middleware.go",

      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "concurrency",
      "title": "Metrics middleware reuses a single mutable wrapper across middleware applications",
      "body": "NewMetricsMiddleware creates one MetricsMiddleware instance and the returned middleware assigns imw.next = next each time it is applied. Middleware factories should return a new wrapper per next while sharing the registered Prometheus collectors. If this middleware is applied more than once, the chains share and overwrite next, which can cause incorrect request routing or data races."
    },

      "title": "TestLogger.FromContext discards logs and contextual fields",
      "body": "TestLogger.FromContext returns a brand-new TestLogger instead of the receiver or a child logger that records into the same captured log fields. Since LoggerMiddleware now emits logs through logger.FromContext(ctx), tests using TestLogger cannot observe those log messages or their contextual key/value pairs."

findings.title: Plugin request logs lose the traceID field
findings.body: The previous LoggerMiddleware explicitly appended traceID from the tracing context to the plugin request log entry. This change removes that explicit field and relies on Logger.FromContext, but the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware only adds endpoint, pluginId, datasource, and user fields. Unless the underlying logging infrastructure independently injects trace IDs, plugin backend request logs will no longer include traceID, reducing trace/log correlation.

findings.title: Metrics middleware reuses a single mutable wrapper across middleware applications
findings.body: NewMetricsMiddleware creates one MetricsMiddleware instance and the returned middleware assigns imw.next = next each time it is applied. Middleware factories should return a new wrapper per next while sharing the registered Prometheus collectors. If this middleware is applied more than once, the chains share and overwrite next, which can cause incorrect request routing or data races.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards logs and contextual fields
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns a brand-new TestLogger instead of the receiver or a child logger that records into the same captured log fields. Since LoggerMiddleware now emits logs through logger.FromContext(ctx), tests using TestLogger cannot observe those log messages or their contextual key/value pairs.

findings.title: No tests for the new contextual logger middleware or FromContext logging
findings.body: The PR introduces ContextualLoggerMiddleware and changes LoggerMiddleware to rely on Logger.FromContext, but the only changed test is the renamed metrics middleware test. There is no coverage verifying that the request context is enriched with the expected attributes or that LoggerMiddleware emits those attributes, so regressions in middleware ordering or missing fields would not be detected.

findings.title: Adding FromContext to the exported Logger interface is a breaking change
findings.body: The exported log.Logger interface now requires FromContext(context.Context) Logger. Any implementation of this interface outside this package will fail to compile after this change. If this interface is considered a public or stable contract, this needs a compatibility plan or explicit release note.
